data.summary: Beispielschutz Versicherung AG confirms a new home contents insurance policy ("Hausratversicherung Plus") for Bastian Musterquell's flat at Quellenweg 7, starting 15 January 2027, with an insured sum of €65,000 and an annual premium of €96.60.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that your application for home contents insurance was accepted and the policy will start on 15 January 2027. There is nothing you need to do now unless you want to check the coverage amount or cancel. The contract renews automatically each year unless either side gives written-form notice (Textform) at least three months before the end of an insurance year; the app will show you the relevant cancellation window if you want to end it. Keep this policy document for your records, as you may need the policy number (Versicherungsschein-Nr.) later for claims or correspondence.
data.tax_note: Household contents insurance (Hausratversicherung) premiums are generally not deductible on a German tax return, unlike some liability insurance contributions.
